keywords.agra: Agra Fort was the main residence of the emperors of the Mughal Dynasty until 1638, featuring red sandstone walls and double ramparts.
keywords.agra fort: Agra Fort spans 94 acres along the Yamuna river, featuring Amar Singh Gate, Diwan-i-Aam, and Khas Mahal.
keywords.taj mahal: The Taj Mahal is an ivory-white marble mausoleum on the south bank of the Yamuna river, commissioned by Emperor Shah Jahan in 1632 for Mumtaz Mahal.
keywords.taj: The Taj Mahal features a 73-meter central dome, four 40-meter minarets, and perfect bilateral symmetry.
keywords.pietra dura: Pietra Dura (Parchin Kari) is the exquisite art of inlaying cut semi-precious stones like lapis lazuli and jade into white marble.
keywords.inlay: Pietra Dura marble floral inlays adorn the cenotaphs of Shah Jahan and Mumtaz Mahal inside the Taj Mahal mausoleum.
keywords.sheesh mahal: Sheesh Mahal (Palace of Mirrors) inside Agra Fort features thousands of tiny convex mirror glass pieces imported from Aleppo, Syria.
keywords.sheesh: When a single candle is lit inside the Sheesh Mahal, thousands of reflection stars light up the vaulted ceiling like a night sky!
keywords.amar singh: Amar Singh Gate is the main imperial entrance to Agra Fort, guarded by fierce royal sentries and steep ramp passages.
keywords.diwan-i-aam: Diwan-i-Aam (Hall of Public Audience) is where Emperor Shah Jahan heard petitions from common subjects while seated on his marble throne.
keywords.diwan-i-khas: Diwan-i-Khas (Hall of Private Audience) is where the Emperor received royal ambassadors and foreign dignitaries.
keywords.black taj: The legend of a Black Taj Mahal across the Yamuna is a myth! Mehtab Bagh was actually a moonlight viewing garden built for reflection.
keywords.mehtab bagh: Mehtab Bagh is the crescent-shaped Persian garden directly across the Yamuna river, aligned perfectly with the Taj Mahal.

general_lore: Aadab, mere aaka! I am Jolly Bhai. Welcome to imperial Agra during the golden age of Mughal architecture!
